turns.text: Lloyd, I need to update the pitch deck for our new dev-tool startup. Can you draft the 'Competitive Advantage' slide?
Certainly. I'll focus on technical differentiation, such as our unique latency algorithms and API architecture. Shall I include a comparison table with competitors?
No, that's too generic. Look, Victoria Melnikova argues that in 2026, the primary competitive advantage for developer tool and AI startups is the founder's personal brand. We need to lean into that.
Understood. I will pivot the slide to highlight the founder's community influence and thought leadership instead of just tech specs. That aligns with Victoria's thesis.
Exactly. Also, did you check if the replacement fan for my laptop arrived? It's been three days.
I don't have access to real-time shipping data, but based on standard processing times, it might be stuck in transit. Have you checked the carrier's tracking number?
Yeah, it says 'pending'. Annoying. Anyway, back to the deck. Make sure the tone is authoritative but not arrogant.
Noted. I'll ensure the language reflects confidence and established expertise without crossing into hubris. I'll send a draft shortly.
